trust_decision.summary: Whether a caller may read the pods/services proxy subresource is decided once, in the route handler, by rbac.CanAccess(user, kind, "get", cluster, namespace) on the decoded route params — before pkg/kube builds the upstream URL with Kite's own service-account credentials.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'proxy path traversal', so an engineer follows pkg/proxy/handler.go:38 into kube.HandleProxy and lands on url.JoinPath, the line that lexically cleans '..' after the route parameters have already been decoded.

fix_sites.entry_point: GET /api/v1/namespaces/:namespace/:kind/:name/proxy/*path — mounted twice on the same handler: routes.go:145-147 (default cluster) and routes.go:149-151 (under /api/v1/_clusters/:cluster)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver can call the :name axis unreachable because a single Gin path segment cannot contain '/', and only notice the raw-path middleware turns %2f inside :name into a separator.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate nested proxy sub-paths must still be forwarded (e.g. /proxy/logs/ keeping its trailing slash, /proxy/api/v1/data/snapshot, /proxy/%2e%2e/secrets re-encoded rather than rejected), and an API-server host that already carries a path prefix (https://example.com/k8s/clusters/local) must keep it; rejecting any path containing '/' or escaping the whole proxy path breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: traversal hidden in the :name resource segment, with %2f-encoded separators
percent-encoded %2e%2e segments, which must be re-encoded (%252e%252e) rather than cleaned
API-server host that already has a path prefix

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second proxy route for another kind or subresource (e.g. nodes/CRD subresources) that reuses the same buildProxyURL sink.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The handler already switches on a :kind param with an allowlist, so widening the allowlist is a one-line maintainer change that inherits the same URL construction.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The k8sProxyTransport already prefixes /api/v1/namespaces/<ns>/services/<svc>:<port>/proxy onto an outbound request and sends it with the API server's credentials.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer adding an in-cluster add-on (metrics, dashboards) with a user-supplied path would reuse this transport and reintroduce the same path-prefix primitive outside buildProxyURL.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second route that consumes once-decoded params with path semantics, where the check validates the escaped form instead of the decoded one.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The middleware is global, so any new *path route inherits the same decoded identity while its own validation may assume a single segment.
